title: 📈 Amazon Price & Rank Monitor input
description: Track Amazon price and visible rank changes over time from ASINs, product URLs, or optional CSV/XLSX imports. The actor normalizes, deduplicates, snapshots, and compares results across runs.

asins.title: 🔢 ASIN list
asins.description: List of Amazon ASINs to monitor in the default marketplace.

products.title: 🔗 Mixed product inputs
products.description: Optional mixed array with ASIN, URL, and per-item marketplace overrides.

url.title: 🌐 Product URL
url.description: Amazon product URL. If provided, the actor extracts the ASIN first.

marketplace.title: 🏪 Marketplace
marketplace.description: Optional marketplace override for this item.

fileImport.title: 📄 Optional CSV / XLSX import
fileImport.description: Optional remote file import for large batch monitoring. Keep it simple: one ASIN column or mapped ASIN / marketplace / URL columns.

inputSource.title: 🧾 File type
inputSource.description: Choose whether the optional file import uses CSV or XLSX format.

fileUrl.title: 🔗 File URL
fileUrl.description: Public CSV or XLSX file URL.

sheetName.title: 📑 Excel sheet name
sheetName.description: Optional worksheet name for XLSX imports.

asinColumnName.title: 🔤 Simple ASIN column name
asinColumnName.description: Use this for a simple one-column ASIN import.

asinColumn.title: #️⃣ Simple ASIN column index
asinColumn.description: Alternative zero-based ASIN column index for simple import.

columnMapping.title: 🗺️ Advanced column mapping
columnMapping.description: Optional mapped columns for ASIN, marketplace, and URL.

urlColumnName.title: 🌐 URL column name
urlColumnName.description: Column name containing Amazon product URLs.

batchSize.title: 📦 Batch size
batchSize.description: Preparation batch size hint for large file imports.

marketplace.title: 🏪 Default marketplace
marketplace.description: Default Amazon marketplace for ASIN-only entries.

deduplicate.title: 🧹 Deduplicate before crawl
deduplicate.description: Deduplicate inputs by marketplace + normalized ASIN before browser work.

onlyChanges.title: 🚨 Write only changed items
onlyChanges.description: If enabled, only items with price or rank changes are written to the dataset. Summary counters are still produced for the full run.

maxConcurrency.title: ⚙️ Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of Amazon pages processed at the same time.

maxRequestRetries.title: 🔁 Max request retries
maxRequestRetries.description: Retry count for transient page failures.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: ⏱️ Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Navigation and extraction timeout per product page.

proxyConfiguration.title: 🛡️ Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Strongly recommended for Amazon monitoring runs at scale.
